map.袢利尿剂间等效剂量换算及袢利尿剂与噻嗪类等效转换: Equivalent dose conversion among loop diuretics and between loop diuretics and thiazides
map.袢利尿剂等效换算：先换算为呋塞米等效剂量 = 原药剂量 × 呋塞米基准量 ÷ 原: Loop diuretic equivalence: first convert to a furosemide-equivalent dose = original drug dose × furosemide reference dose ÷ original drug reference dose; then convert to the target drug = furosemide-equivalent × target drug reference dose ÷ furosemide reference dose.
map.最常用，口服吸收波动大: Most commonly used, oral absorption varies widely
map.可用于磺胺过敏者: Can be used in patients allergic to sulfonamides
map.📋 袢利尿剂与噻嗪类等效参考: 📋 Equivalence reference between loop diuretics and thiazides
map.注：袢利尿剂与噻嗪类作用机制和部位不同，等效换算仅为临床参考，不能完全等同替换。: Note: loop diuretics and thiazides differ in mechanism and site of action; the equivalent conversion is a clinical reference only and they cannot be substituted one-for-one.
map.提示：呋塞米口服生物利用度个体差异大(10-100%)，静脉给药效价约为口服的2: Note: oral furosemide bioavailability varies greatly between individuals (10-100%), and the intravenous potency is about twice the oral potency (oral 40 mg ≈ IV 20 mg). Torasemide and bumetanide have stable bioavailability. CKD patients often need high doses of loop diuretics. This tool is for learning reference only; follow medical advice for actual medication.
map.等效托拉塞米 20mg 或布美他尼 1mg（呋:托=2:1，呋:布=40:1）。: Equivalent to torasemide 20 mg or bumetanide 1 mg (furosemide:torasemide = 2:1, furosemide:bumetanide = 40:1).
map.托拉塞米 20mg→呋塞米 40mg，注意口服生物利用度差异。: Torasemide 20 mg → furosemide 40 mg; watch for the difference in oral bioavailability.
map.不同袢利尿剂效价不同，换药按等效剂量避免过量或不足。: Different loop diuretics have different potencies; switch by equivalent dose to avoid overdose or underdose.
map.呋塞米在肾衰仍可用，托拉塞米肝代谢受肝功能影响。: Furosemide remains usable in renal failure, while torasemide is metabolized by the liver and affected by liver function.
